demand.title: Missing data demand
demand.lead: Companies users could not find data for, grouped by code: how many times, how many people, the latest time and the datasets asked for. Aggregated only; it never says who asked. We decide what to collect.
demand.howToStart: To collect one, click “Start ingestion”: it opens the info console's Securities page with the code filled in; press “Start ingestion” there.
demand.infoAdminUnset: The info console URL (INFO_ADMIN_URL) is not configured: only codes are listed here; start ingestions by hand on the info console's Securities page.
demand.failed: Could not load. Try again later.
demand.none: Nobody has run into missing data yet.
demand.noDataset: (an expert step reported it is not ingested)
